# T4SKAG3NT 0.1.8 Local Model Roles and Progress
This update makes local model downloads and assignments explicit:
- Asks whether each newly downloaded model should become the main coordination model or remain available for specialist sub-agents. - Shows the designated coordination model and its readiness directly on the AI models setup page. - Keeps one or more active model downloads visible after the model library closes. - Labels every active download by its intended coordinator or sub-agent role. - Supports multiple concurrent model downloads while applying the storage safety limit to their combined size. - Detects partial model downloads accurately and resumes selected downloads after an app relaunch or update. - Preserves all selected local models so the coordinator and sub-agents can route work to them after setup.

# T4SKAG3NT 0.1.7 Provider Registration Refinement
This update refines the new model and provider setup experience:
- Keeps cloud providers visibly unregistered after relaunch until their API key has been verified again. - Preserves selected model preferences without ever writing setup credentials into the setup draft. - Includes the expanded, hardware-filtered local MLX model library introduced in 0.1.6.

# T4SKAG3NT 0.1.6 Model Setup Update
This update makes the AI model setup cleaner and more capable:
- Detects compatible local models already downloaded on the Mac. - Adds a focused local model library with a broader set of verified Hugging Face MLX models, filtered for this Mac's memory. - Offers small, balanced, and higher-capability model families from Qwen, Llama, Gemma, Phi, and Mistral where the hardware permits. - Replaces inline cloud credentials with a guided provider registration window. - Verifies OpenAI and Anthropic API keys directly with the provider before registration. - Loads the supported models available to the registered account and allows one or more to be selected. - Stores provider keys securely in Apple Keychain and preserves compatibility with existing settings.
